name: ES vs CL Intraday Correlation by CL Volatility Regime
description: Rolling 12-bar (60-minute equivalent) Pearson correlation between ES and CL 5-minute returns, restricted to 8:00–11:30 AM ET. Days are classified by PREVIOUS session's CL absolute return: 'High Vol CL' (|return| > 2%) vs 'Quiet CL' (≤ 2%). Includes: (1) time-series correlation chart with regime overlay, (2) boxplot comparing correlation distributions by regime, (3) summary table with stats for each regime.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES vs CL Intraday Rolling Correlation — 8:00–11:30 AM ET
# =============================================================================
# 12-bar rolling Pearson correlation on 5-min returns (≈ 60-min window)
# Session: 8:00–11:30 AM ET (US/Europe overlap)
# ES = primary asset (market_data_source)
# CL = reference (reference_futures → futures_continuation)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCES ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
es_close = es_cont.c

cl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(cl_ref.o, cl_ref.h, cl_ref.l, cl_ref.c, cl_ref.v, cl_ref.oi, cl_ref.s)
cl_close = ffill(cl_cont.c)

# === 5-MIN RETURNS ===
es_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(es_close)
cl_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(cl_close)

# === 12-BAR ROLLING CORRELATION ===
corr_12 = rolling_corr(window=12, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=es_ret, y=cl_ret)

# === SESSION FILTER: 8:00–11:30 AM ET ===
# time_of_day = minutes since midnight: 8:00 = 480, 11:30 = 690
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(index())
is_session = (bar_tod >= 480 and bar_tod < 690)

# Mask correlation to session bars only (null outside session)
session_corr = where(is_session, corr_12)

# === CL SESSION RETURN & REGIME CLASSIFICATION ===
# Use session_window to get CL open/close for the 8:00–11:30 AM ET window
cl_session = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(open=cl_cont.o, high=cl_cont.h, low=cl_cont.l, close=cl_close)

# At session end, compute absolute CL return for the session
cl_sess_abs_ret = where(cl_session.closed, abs(cl_session.close / cl_session.open - 1.0))

# ffill the session return → each bar within the session carries the current session's
# classification (computed from session open vs current close, updated bar-by-bar)
# For same-session classification, use the running session return directly
cl_running_abs_ret = where(is_session, abs(cl_close / ffill(cl_session.open) - 1.0))
cl_day_abs_ret = ffill(where(cl_session.closed, abs(cl_session.close / cl_session.open - 1.0)))
is_high_vol = cl_day_abs_ret > 0.02   # >2% absolute session return = High Vol CL

# Split session correlation by regime
high_vol_corr = where(is_session and is_high_vol, corr_12)
quiet_corr = where(is_session and (not is_high_vol), corr_12)

# Positive correlation flags by regime
is_pos_highvol = where(is_session and is_high_vol, (1.0 if corr_12 > 0 else 0.0))
is_pos_quiet = where(is_session and (not is_high_vol), (1.0 if corr_12 > 0 else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Rolling Correlation Line Chart (all session bars) ---
xy_lines(
    title='12-Bar Rolling Correlation: ES vs CL Returns (8:00–11:30 AM ET, 5-Min)',
    category='1. Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='12-Bar Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=session_corr)

# --- 2. Correlation Distribution by CL Regime (Boxplot) ---
boxplot(
    title='Correlation Distribution: High Vol CL (>2%) vs Quiet CL (≤2%)',
    category='2. Distribution by Regime',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['High Vol CL (>2%)', 'Quiet CL (≤2%)'],
    colors=[Color.Red, Color.Blue]
)(values=(high_vol_corr, quiet_corr))

# --- 3. Summary Statistics by Regime ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES vs CL Correlation Stats by CL Volatility Regime',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Avg Correlation', 'Median Correlation', 'Std Dev', 'Min', 'Max', '% Time Positive'],
        col_headers=['High Vol CL (>2%)', 'Quiet CL (≤2%)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Summary Stats'
)(high_vol_corr, quiet_corr, high_vol_corr, quiet_corr, high_vol_corr, quiet_corr, high_vol_corr, quiet_corr, high_vol_corr, quiet_corr, is_pos_highvol, is_pos_quiet)
